title: Simplify Alpha™ opens AI engineering and innovation center in Hyderabad, joined by Simplify Healthcare® and SimplifyX™
summary: Hyderabad joins Pune and Mumbai as the third India location for the Simplify Group™ companies, adding capacity for customer delivery and growth.
llm_summary: Simplify Alpha™ has launched an AI engineering and innovation hub in Hyderabad, expanding the Simplify Group™’s presence in India beyond Pune and Mumbai. The new center, alongside Simplify Healthcare® and SimplifyX™, boosts the company’s capacity to deliver AI‑driven solutions and supports its growth strategy across the region.
